Frozen: the title, the why, the body, the depends_on links, and the parent. Free: options, sources, kill criterion state, and comments.

A change to a frozen field is a proposal (#al-diff-cli). Your ✓ amends the card: it reopens and decides it in one step, so the map never shows it open. The amend marks the next hop (#vi-prop).

The amend runs the decide facts (#werk-contract-facts) on the new version, so it can fail in two cases:
- The change removes a fact, for example the last depends_on link.
- The card was decided before a fact became required, for example a kill criterion. The amend waits until that fact is added.

An open or proto card is not frozen. It changes through a proposal and marks nothing, because no card can be decided on it.
